top_paper.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
top_paper.summary: SimpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.

papers.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
papers.summary: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.

papers.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
papers.summary: NorthCUA scales computer-use agents via an experience flywheel, recursive self-improvement, staged learning, and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art open-source GUI and web interaction results.

papers.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
papers.summary: Wave Forcing enables efficient continuous long-video generation with consistent appearance and natural motion through co-designed generation, training, and execution, achieving high throughput and quality.

papers.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
papers.summary: TinyAstral improves robot agent harnesses via recursive self-improvement and distills compact students that retain performance gains with lower compute.

papers.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
papers.summary: ReTrace is a framework that evaluates recovery behavior in computer-use agents by formalizing transition-consistent recovery and demonstrating that autonomous model-based recovery improves long-horizon reliability.

papers.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Agent harnesses integrate video generation and world models to enable planning, tool use, and recursive self-improvement for autonomous multi-shot video production.

papers.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.summary: Multimodal language models fail at multi-step visual reasoning due to a reference gap rather than perception, and task-matched external references like numbering significantly improve accuracy without training.

papers.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
papers.summary: Embedding research across modalities is converging toward shared principles via contrastive learning and Transformers, and a framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality is proposed to unify it through transformation, alignment, and joint embedding.

papers.title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
papers.summary: MAServeBench evaluates LLM serving and hardware by modeling multi-agent collaboration as a configurable workload dimension with reproducible dependency traces.

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
papers.summary: Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation improves on-policy self-distillation by continuously enhancing self-teaching reliability through reward-guided teacher optimization and adaptive down-weighting of unreliable samples.

papers.title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
papers.summary: Auxiliary trajectory preferences based on entropy and confidence metrics improve small language model self-improvement and transfer by distinguishing learning value among equally correct reasoning traces.

papers.title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
papers.summary: ProVe reverses speculative decoding roles by fine-tuning a large model to propose token blocks and verifying them with a smaller or identical model, achieving faster autoregressive generation with adjustable speed-accuracy tradeoffs.

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
papers.summary: DecisionRank uses item-space on-policy distillation to transfer ranking knowledge from generative teachers to efficient decision models, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval performance with significantly faster inference.

papers.title: DeFT-RAG: Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
papers.summary: DeFT-RAG improves multi-hop question answering by generating self-contained sub-questions sequentially, offloading reasoning to rule-based updates and a lightweight decision model, and caching answers to reduce LLM usage.

papers.title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
papers.summary: TSFLab is a self-improving agent-agnostic workbench that equips coding agents with shared resources to reduce costs and automate maintenance for time series forecasting research and benchmarking.

papers.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
papers.summary: SOMA is a benchmark assessing fine-grained egocentric body-motion reasoning in multimodal models, revealing substantial gaps versus human performance and providing training data and a multimodal baseline to advance the field.

papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
papers.summary: GEPA-Curator improves agentic prompt optimization by filtering unreliable failure signals and retrieving past successes, boosting performance across multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
papers.summary: AuditFL is a blockchain-backed clearing layer that makes federated learning rounds auditable and economically constrained without removing the aggregator, preserving model accuracy under failures.

papers.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
papers.summary: SimpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.

papers.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
papers.summary: Frontier AI research agents propose many sound experiments but show limited ability to rank them better than simple baselines, with teams offering no clear quality gains.

papers.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
papers.summary: OSWAM enables real-time, high-quality action generation in autonomous driving and embodied control by initializing diffusion with structured imagination tokens and distilling future-conditioned privileged information into a single denoising step.

papers.title: Think Twice: The Metis-1.6 Technical Report
papers.summary: Metis-1.6 introduces small, efficient mixture-of-experts language models trained with limited data that achieve competitive math performance and Pareto-optimal efficiency despite training errors and architectural issues.

papers.title: TurnTurk-GPT: Text-Based Turn-Taking Prediction for Turkish
papers.summary: TurnTurk-GPT, a Turkish turn-taking predictor fine-tuned from GPT-2, outperforms multilingual detectors and reveals that Turkish end-of-turn cues rely on verb-final morphology.

papers.title: When Requirements Interact: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding via Interdependent Specifications
papers.summary: CodeSpecWeave synthesizes complex, interdependent software development tasks with verified tests to train coding agents, improving performance on long-horizon benchmarks.

papers.title: Learning Quality-Controllable Robot Policies with Iterative Hindsight Relabeling
papers.summary: Quality-Controllable Policy enables real-time adjustment of robot execution quality and improves performance through iterative hindsight relabeling of online rollouts.

papers.title: Supervising the Visible State: Separating Representation from View Selection in Streaming Video
papers.summary: Visible-State Supervision and Test-Time Causal View Search improve streaming action recognition by separating representation learning from evidence selection, boosting accuracy with fewer frames.

papers.title: Venus-DefakerOne2: A Vision-Forensics Foundation Model with Broader Coverage
papers.summary: Venus-DefakerOne2 is a unified anti-forgery foundation model that extends detection to diverse forgery forms and media types through alternating LoRA and full-parameter tuning and entropy-based test adaptation.

papers.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
papers.summary: MemSteer generates evidence-grounded QA supervision from unlabeled user histories to optimize agent memory design without model updates, improving benchmark scores significantly.

papers.title: VoxLock: Target-Speaker Extraction for Voice Agents Without an Enrollment Step
papers.summary: A fine-tuned causal target-speaker extraction model achieves near-commercial speech recognition accuracy on real recordings with low CPU usage and latency.

papers.title: SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World
papers.summary: SciGame evaluates scientific discovery agents using structured cards with counterfactual environments to separate prior knowledge from empirical evidence, revealing that exact symbolic law recovery remains a key challenge.
